description.p: Hotel Anvelope keeps track of the tyre sets a workshop stores for its customers, from the moment they come through the door until they are handed back. It replaces the notebook and the spreadsheet with one simple flow: intake, label, shelf, release.
An account on anvelope.app is required; a free plan is available.

ul.li: Fast intake with customer, vehicle, size, season, tread depth and rim details
QR labels for thermal printers or A4 sheets, one at a time or in batches
Shelves and locations with real capacity, so you know how many sets still fit
A record for every customer and vehicle, with the full history of each set
Storage fees per season, PDF deposit receipts, payments and outstanding balances
Automatic e-mail reminders when the season changes or storage expires
Offline mode: intake and release keep working without internet, and sync afterwards
Colleagues with different roles, an activity log, and CSV or Excel export

description.p: Note: scanning QR labels with a camera is available in the iOS, Android and macOS versions. On Linux the WebKitGTK webview has no camera access, so set codes are typed instead.
